thread:
chris: Can we add a preview-only path in the console that shows routing impact heatmap for a config change before apply? PMs keep asking for "what flips if I change X".

leah: yes, we've had requests. Idea: dry-run compute merge for each tenant cohort and render percent of traffic that would change route.

devin: Important: dry-run must use the same merge + cache behavior as runtime (incl. prefix KV cache) otherwise results will differ.

chris: True. We should run dry-run against a snapshot of current runtime state so it's deterministic. Also mark results as "estimation" with 95% CI.

leah: Telemetry: emit `dryrun.route_flip_fraction{tenant}` and `dryrun.estimate_confidence{tenant}`. Add histogram of token-latency for dry-run to avoid perf regressions.

devin: UX: show top-10 affected tenants and a small flamegraph of flow change. Add an "auto-suggest safe delta" that highlights keys causing most flips.

chris: Security: ensure dry-run can't be used to enumerate tenant data. Rate-limit and require owner perms.

ops-bot: queued task: staging dry-run service branch created (build/4321).

leah: Rollout: 1) internal-only in console for 48h, 2) gather telemetry and compare dry-run vs actual flips on small canary, 3) open to PMs.

devin: We'll also add a follow-up alert if dryrun.route_flip_fraction correlates >0.5 with real route flips during canary.

chris: I'll draft a short runbook for using the preview and guidance on interpreting CI.

ops-bot: deploy: dry-run frontend toggled in staging (ui/2211).

leah: ok landing. Will post PRs and example queries in follow-up. :rocket:
